metaDescription: Order custom counter banners for trade shows and retail. Durable vinyl with stands. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Counter banners are designed for tabletops and retail counters, offering a compact yet highly visible display option. Unlike larger banners that hang or stand on the floor, counter banners sit directly on surfaces, making them ideal for point-of-purchase promotions, registration desks, and product launches. Printed on durable vinyl with a choice of Eurofit steel bases, these banners assemble quickly without tools. Choose from sizes like 2' x 4' or 3' x 7' to fit your counter space. Customize with full-color graphics to capture attention at your next event.
heroAltText: Custom counter banners on display at a trade show table with vibrant full-color printing and metal stand bases.
